title: Built AI Agent for LinkedIn Newsletter
content: Battling content fatigue and flat newsletter engagement? We deployed a custom AI agent to revolutionize our strategy. The results are compelling. Our AI agent delivered a 17% increase in open rates, 12% boost in click-through rates, and 25% more engagement. It also reduced drafting effort significantly. We used fine-tuned LLMs, prompt engineering, and brand-aligned knowledge bases. This approach can extend to blogs, social media, and personalized emails.
cta: What is the top content challenge you want AI to solve for your team?
